name_reason: Name follows convention data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> and matches its sibling data_fd2_chapter_event_handler_27_drop_entry_inline. The '29' is the dispatch-table index 0x29 (the owning handler's slot in the per-event handler table at 0x51B91), a meaningful domain ID -- not a Ghidra address residue (the home address is 0x52745, not 0x29). 'drop_entry_inline' correctly reflects the data role (an inline drop-entry blob). No address-suffix residue present.
purpose: Inline 3-byte battle-drop entry blob baked into the binary at 0x52745, read only by fd2_chapter_event_handler_29__ch17_eye_gem_drop, which copies all 3 bytes onto a stack local and hands it as a one-entry array to fd2_process_battle_drop_entries(recipient, 1, &blob).
logic_summary: Follows the drop-entry ABI consumed by fd2_process_battle_drop_entries: byte[0] = entry type, byte[1..2] = little-endian uint16 value. Contents = {0x00, 0xD5, 0x00} => type 0 (ITEM pickup), value 0x00D5 = item id 0xD5. The handler grants item 0xD5 to the stepping char, but fd2_process_battle_drop_entries only opens the type-0/1 drop-reward dialog when the recipient is on the player team (runtime_char.bTeam == 2); for a non-player recipient the entry is skipped (early return). Verified item 0xD5 = 冰之眼 (the hidden-chapter entry item) against fd2-knowledge.
element_semantics: [0] = drop entry type (0x00 = ITEM pickup, per the type switch in fd2_process_battle_drop_entries: 0=item,1=gold,2=battle-event,3=scripted-dialog); [1..2] = little-endian uint16 value, interpreted by entry type -- here item id 0xD5 (冰之眼).
notes: Sole reader fd2_chapter_event_handler_29__ch17_eye_gem_drop @ 0x34FF0 (xrefs: READ @ 0x35006, DATA @ 0x35001 via MOV ESI,0x52745 + MOVSW + MOVSB = exactly 3 bytes copied; entry_count passed = 1, confirming the global is exactly 3 bytes). Only xrefs are reads (no game-side writer) -> truly const. src comment block (chevt1.c ~lines 1852-1861) is already accurate, concise, and ASCII-clean (only the allowed proper item name 冰之眼 is non-ASCII); kept as-is, src not edited. Ghidra plate was empty (NULL) -> created a concise plate reflecting the src conclusion. Name rename (if ever) deferred to Stage 2; this stage records keep only.
